National Stock Exchange of India Limited

Bandra (E), Mumbai – 400 051 
NSE Symbol: AXISBANK 
BSE Limited 
P. J. Towers,  
Dalal Street  
Fort, Mumbai – 400 001 
 
 
BSE Scrip Code: 532215 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
REF.: 
DISCLOSURE UNDER REGULATION 30 OF THE SEBI (LISTING OBLIGATIONS AND 
DISCLOSURE REQUIREMENTS) REGULATIONS, 2015 (“SEBI LISTING REGULATIONS”) 
 
SUB.: 
AUDIO RECORDING OF EARNINGS CALL OF AXIS BANK LIMITED (“BANK”) FOR THE 
QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026 
 
In reference to our letter no AXIS/CO/CS/456/2026-27 dated October 12, 2026, we hereby 
inform you that pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, the Bank has 
conducted an earnings call with analysts and investors today i.e., October 17, 2026, on 
unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results of the Bank for the quarter and half 
year ended September 30, 2026.  
 
The audio recording of the said call is available on the website of the Bank at: 
https://www.axis.bank.in/shareholders-corner/other-information/audio-call-transcript 
 
This is for your information and records.  
 
Thanking You.  
 
With warm regards, 
 
For Axis Bank Limited  
 
 
 
Sandeep Poddar  
Company Secretary  
 
CC: London Stock Exchange 
        Singapore Stock Exchange 
 
SANDEEP 
PODDAR
Digitally signed by 
SANDEEP PODDAR 
Date: 2026.10.17
